profile.headline: Software and systems developer
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with a rich tapestry of skills spanning various domains. My expertise lies in the world of distributed systems development, where I can navigate the complexities of wired and wireless networking. I'm proficient in an array of programming languages, including C/C++, Rust, Go, Python, and Lisp, and have a deep understanding of operating systems like Linux (Redhat, Ubuntu), VxWorks, eCOS, along with a spectrum of embedded systems. My background in hardware and Verilog design helps me navigate the complexities of developing various systems.
My proficiency extends to creating nuanced solutions backed by my in-depth knowledge of ARM, MIPS, and PPC processor architectures. I'm also well-versed in various wireless technologies, including the latest in 802.11 protocols, LTE, Multi-user MIMO, Ultrawideband, GSM, and 802.16.
I've several years of experience with multi-cloud deployments in AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure and have utilized Terraform and Crossplane infrastructure as code environments. I excel in orchestrating Kubernetes, Rancher, and Docker-based microservce based infrastructures in cloud and on-premises environments, ensuring seamless configuration of VPCs, VMs, Load Balancers, and robust deployment of security policies. I've successfully steered and led Cogniac through numerous SOC2 security-focused audits.
I bring ideas to life in web development with Flask, NGINX, and UWSGI, crafting responsive and user-friendly web solutions. My leadership skills shine as I build and guide highly talented teams, steering projects to success with a focus on innovation and quality.
I have experience in leveraging tools like PyTorch, and TensorFlow and harnessing the power of FFMPEG and OpenCV for advanced video processing. Additionally, I've deployed several edge and cloud computing deep-learning inference systems. I'm currently investigating graph-based RAG for LLMs and have fine-tuned multi-mode models.  My diverse skill set highlights my technical understanding and underscores my passion for staying ahead in the rapidly evolving tech landscape.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description: My responsibilities span across multiple cross-functional areas - from architecting the software for our cutting-edge Computer Vision platform to leading a large team of engineers. My role encompasses software development for edge and cloud deployments and managing the DevOps aspects of our multi-cloud architecture. Additionally, I handle customer support and security audits, participate in the recruitment process, and play a crucial role in defining the strategic roadmap. I'm also actively conducting customer demonstrations. My portfolio is as diverse as it is challenging, reflecting a comprehensive engagement with various facets of our operations.
